::: {.block title="Methods"}
One boosted regression tree per 10 m bin predicts log10 CHLA from PACE Rrs,
local solar hour and platform. Solar hour lets the model learn daytime
quenching in the in situ fluorescence. Satellite values are L3 daily maps with
no overpass time, so each profile is matched to its day's map at the nearest
4 km cell. Skill is measured on held-out data: grouped 5-fold cross-validation
over 1° × 30-day blocks, repeated 5 times. We report R² of log10 CHLA per bin,
of integrated CHLA (surface to 200 m or the deepest bin), and peak-depth error.
:::
